Definition: Jechizkijah, the name of five Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Hezekiah or Jehizkiah = "Jehovah has made strong"; 1) son of king Ahazby Abi or Abijah and the 12th king of Judah; his reign was characterised by his godly conduct; reigned for 29 years; 2) head of a family of returning exiles in the time of Nehemiah; 3) an Ephraimite in the time of Ahaz
